description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Cost 2 charges of Ghost-Static

Duration 1 minute

You unfold a second, smaller chassis from your kit. The drone is a Tiny construct minion with your Rig's AC, saves, and Perception, and Hit Points equal to your level; it acts when you spend an action to command it. It cannot Redline, cannot carry mods, and is destroyed at 0 Hit Points. When the duration ends it folds itself away.
